description: This file implements the BookingAuditTaskerProducerService class, which manages queuing of booking audit actions via a task queue system, using various audit action services and handling actor identification and feature flag checks.

classes.name: BookingAuditTaskerProducerService
classes.description: Implements the BookingAuditProducerService interface, providing methods to queue various booking audit actions, both individual and bulk, with actor resolution and feature flag checks.

methods.name: getPIIFreeBookingAuditActor
methods.description: Resolves an actor to a PII-free version based on identification method, creating or fetching actor records as needed.

methods.name: queueTask
methods.description: Internal helper to enqueue a single audit task with actor resolution, feature flag checks, and error handling.

methods.name: queueRescheduleRequestedAudit
methods.description: Queues a 'reschedule requested' booking audit action.

methods.name: queueAttendeeAddedAudit
methods.description: Queues an 'attendee added' booking audit action.

methods.name: queueNoShowUpdatedAudit
methods.description: Queues a 'no-show updated' booking audit action.

methods.name: queueAttendeeRemovedAudit
methods.description: Queues an 'attendee removed' booking audit action.

methods.name: queueLocationChangedAudit
methods.description: Queues a 'location changed' booking audit action.

methods.name: queueSeatBookedAudit
methods.description: Queues a 'seat booked' booking audit action.

methods.name: queueSeatRescheduledAudit
methods.description: Queues a 'seat rescheduled' booking audit action.

methods.name: queueBulkTask
methods.description: Internal helper to enqueue bulk booking audit actions with actor resolution and feature flag checks.
